async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Author' button to open the filter dropdown
    author_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Author', exact=True)
    await author_button.click()
    # Wait for the filter input to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Fill in the author filter with 'Steven Woodson'
    # Look for a textbox with role 'textbox' and name containing 'author' or similar
    author_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Filter by author', exact=False)
    if await author_input.count() == 0:
        # Try alternative if not found
        author_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Author', exact=False)
    await author_input.fill('Steven Woodson')
    # Find and fill the date filter
    date_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Date', exact=False)
    if await date_input.count() == 0:
        date_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Filter by date', exact=False)
    await date_input.fill('2023-02-06')
    # Apply the filter; press Enter in the date input as a common way to apply
    await date_input.press('Enter')
    # Wait for the page to update
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Count the number of commits displayed
    # Commits are links under the main role; use get_by_role to find all links and filter
    # First, get the main section
    main_section = page.get_by_role('main')
    # Get all links within the main section
    all_links = main_section.get_by_role('link')
    # Initialize count
    commit_count = 0
    # Iterate through links to count those that are commit messages
    # Based on the tree, commit message links have URLs containing '/-/commit/'
    # Use get_by_role and filter by checking the href attribute via get_attribute
    for i in range(await all_links.count()):
        link = all_links.nth(i)
        href = await link.get_attribute('href')
        if href and '/-/commit/' in href:
            commit_count += 1
    # Return the count as a string
    return str(commit_count)
